title: Metal detector search finds the crash site upturned
summary: James Fox tells of Metal detector search finds the crash site upturned, about c. 2025 at Varginha, Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: me and he's like, "Man, this whole area has been all upturned.

plain: James Fox, a man investigating a story of a UFO crash near the town of Varginha, Brazil, says that around 2025 he searched the reported crash site with a metal detector. He says the person with him told him the whole area had been dug up and turned over. He tells it because, if true, it suggests someone had already cleared away whatever was there.
